title: I Posted the Marina Slip Quiet Hours the Owner's Yacht Ignored

parts.text: I bunked on slip 18 at 11:08 p.m. and the owner's yacht generator was a nightclub. The quiet-hours flyer he posted on the dock box said: GENERATORS OFF 10 P.M. TO 7 A.M. I was thirty-six, liveaboard, holding a decibel app that already read 67. Owner Grant said from the flybridge, "Owner vessels are facilities." I pointed at his flyer. He toasted. "Facilities don't sleep." I photographed the flyer, the generator, and the reading. Then I posted all three on the harbor board he moderated. At 11:16 the harbormaster asked why Grant's hull number was on a quiet-hours ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The harbormaster can see the yacht generator against the flyer Grant posted.

social.video_title: The owner's yacht ignored his own quiet hours — Part 1/2
social.description: Liveaboard, a flybridge toast, and a dock-box flyer. I posted the reading. Would you have worn earplugs?

parts.text: Grant called it a charger until the liveaboards asked for the log. I printed the ticket, the flyer, and the photo. The generator died at 11:40. Grant ran inverter and told the dock the flyer was always about optics. Optics is a word owners use when a decibel app exists. Slip policy now has a second line: OWNER VESSELS ARE NOT FACILITIES AFTER TEN. I sleep. Grant shoreside-charges. The water finally sounds like water.

social.video_title: Owner vessels are not facilities after ten — Part 2/2
social.description: Quiet-hours ticket, inverter night, and a second line on the flyer. Was charging ever a nightclub?
